decisions.reason: The accelerator program costs little to keep and remains publicly promoted, but it sits outside the core machinery business, and after C was dropped management may prune peripheral offers, so its survival is uncertain.

As a publicly announced flagship of the firm's CO2-negative circular-materials direction with sunk development investment, the bitumen binder will be defended and its slow uptake attributed to early-market conditions.
The mobile SNOWFLAKE plant is central to the modular, decentralized WASTX recycling strategy and close to the core business, making withdrawal very unlikely.
